notes: The new creatures (PLAN-CREATURES.md; NOTES.md 'New creatures'). Read by game/creatures.cpp; behind the option 'New creatures' (default On), with Leveling on or off. Facts from specs/world/creature_facts.md.

body: the engine shape (data/shapes/shapes.json 2060-2064) that carries HP, collision and the monster row; draw: what the engine draws instead, [shape, first, last, game frames a step] or "own" (the body's own stand frame). Phases: water and lava creatures are hidden (under), rising, up (only then hittable when a rule says so) and sinking; walkers and floaters are always up.

Stats (hp, dex, str, damage, armour) are used both with Leveling on (as its level variant) and off (as the monster row). level and xp: Leveling's kill XP, the same per level as data/monster_levels.json (24, 152, 176 for levels 6, 7, 8), counted in test_leveling's budget and pacing. damage_type: the bits of combat.md 1 (1 normal, 2 blade, 8 fire, 0x80 pierce).

rules: the first rule whose 'when' tags are all on a hit sets its damage to pct percent. Tags of a hit: weapon (a melee blow) or spell (anything else: spells, blasts, traps); blade, blunt, fire, undead, magic, pierce (its damage bits); magic_weapon (a weapon in magic_weapons, or one whose damage has the magic bit, or a daemon's blow); a companion spell's id and its spell_tags; grant_peace (an Avatar spell of type 0xA8 with no companion spell named); lava; and the creature's state: hidden, weakened.

magic_weapons: the eight artifact weapons (creature_facts.md 3). metal_armour: [shape, frame] by picture (creature_facts.md 6, unconfirmed there); -1 = every frame; a piece's odd frame counts as its even one. spell_tags: elements for the companions' spells (the Avatar's damaging spells are all plain fire or normal, creature_facts.md 4; no Avatar spell is water).

places: where each rises, the first time the Avatar is on that map with the option on ('after': only once that critical-path step is done). Each place once per game. Checked by tests/test_creatures.cpp (places): free, in its habitat, near a spot the party can stand on that a flood of the real collision tests reaches from the map's arrivals. 'alt': the same place in another state of the map (24 and 25 are one tunnel), not counted twice in the XP budget.
